claim_boundary: Ranked inventory for independent replay. Not an admission count. Canonical88 stays 88. Release containment is a separate publication tier.

rules.canonical88: exclude strict 88 identities; do not edit the ledger
rules.conflicts: fail-closed on equal-or-stronger causal disagreement; later causal FAIL vetoes; weaker earlier NARROW is a conflict ref only
rules.dedupe: uppercase GHSA plus mechanism fingerprint or exact candidate/fix sets; shared SHA alone is not duplicate
